name: @jeswr/sparq
description: RDF/JS interface to the sparq SPARQL engine (Rust → WebAssembly): an in-memory, dictionary-encoded RDF store with SELECT/ASK and SPARQL Update.

scripts._copy:wasm: rm -rf wasm && mkdir wasm && cp ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm.js ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm.d.ts ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm_bg.wasm ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts wasm/
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --no-opt -- --features shacl,jsonld,serialize-rdf,scs,canon,explain-json,native-ttl --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _optimize:wasm -- ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm_bg.wasm -O3 && npm run _copy:wasm
scripts.build:wasm:lean: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --no-opt -- --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _optimize:wasm -- ../crates/sparq-wasm/pkg/sparq_wasm_bg.wasm -O3 && npm run _copy:wasm
scripts.build:reason-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-reason-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --no-opt -- --features explain --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _optimize:wasm -- ../crates/sparq-reason-wasm/pkg/sparq_reason_wasm_bg.wasm -Oz
scripts.build:rsp-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-rsp-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --no-opt -- --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _optimize:wasm -- ../crates/sparq-rsp-wasm/pkg/sparq_rsp_wasm_bg.wasm -Oz
scripts.build:shacl-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-shacl-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --no-opt -- --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _optimize:wasm -- ../crates/sparq-shacl-wasm/pkg/sparq_shacl_wasm_bg.wasm -Oz
scripts.build:text-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/sparq-text-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --no-opt -- --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _optimize:wasm -- ../crates/sparq-text-wasm/pkg/sparq_text_wasm_bg.wasm -Oz
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.prepack:skills: rm -rf skills AGENTS.md && cp -R ../skills skills && cp ../AGENTS.md AGENTS.md
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run prepack:skills
